configuration.pca: min(64, raw_feature_dimension); bypass when raw dimension <= 64, as in Track 5

sar.second_pass: re-filter first-pass reliable samples; recover using second-pass entropy EMA

eata.fisher: mean squared per-sample source OOF ensemble BCE gradients at scale=1, bias=0

corruptions.dual_fm_gauss_noise: N(0, 3^2) on ctranspath and plip; independent RNG seed 42 + FM index
corruptions.temp_scale_miscalibration: uni2_h x0.2, phikon and plip x5, kaiko_vitl14 +0.5
corruptions.single_fm_dead_zero_macro: zero target PCA features before logistic scoring; classifier intercept remains

bootstrap.p_value: two-sided class-stratified paired AUROC bootstrap, matching Track 5

configuration.macro: arithmetic mean across six per-FM metrics; bootstrap pairs the same target cases across all six shifts
configuration.fdr_family: non-reference methods within each dataset and regime (or per-FM breakdown); reference p=q=1
